verdict.rationale: The only documented multi-item action is item merging, which combines multiple items into one group. The REST API supports filtered, paginated listing of items, and items have statuses and owners, but nothing shows those being changed across many items at once. Missing for 10: documented bulk status changes (resolve/mute/archive), bulk owner assignment, a bulk API endpoint or bulk MCP tool for agents, and any hands-on corroboration.
